title: Document the contribution setup workflow
body:
## Context
New contributors need a clear, repeatable explanation of the local setup workflow and the boundaries of their first change. This issue keeps that guidance close to the repository.

## Task
- [ ] Update `src/app.ts` and the contributor documentation with the bounded setup steps.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The expected result is described for every supported environment.

## Verification
Run the tests and verify the documented commands from a clean checkout.

title: Pull request returned by the issues endpoint
body: This pull request must never appear as an issue card.
